body:
If you’re a brand owner or an entrepreneur, you must clearly understand the true importance of branding.‍

Knowing how to develop a brand is essential since it is the process of identifying and distinguishing a firm from its competitors.

What are the best podcast about branding?

Fortunately, in this generation, when everything is accessible online, you can have a lot of sources that you can check out, and that includes listening to podcasts about branding.

Listening to podcasts is one of the most effective ways to learn anything, including disciplines like branding.

You are able to learn from the practitioners and branding experts by just listening to the podcast hosts’ interviews with them.

I created a list of top podcasts about branding that will surely help you with your needs as a brand and business owner.

Whether you’re just a startup or an experienced one in this field, you can surely still learn something from these podcasts, especially on the On Branding Podcast.

However, if you want to learn more about brand strategy, you can also check out my other article where you can learn how to become a brand strategist.

So without further ado, here are my top 10 best branding podcasts that you can listen to on Spotify, Apple Podcast, Google Podcast, and other podcasting platforms as well.

10 Best Branding Podcasts

  1. On Branding Podcast
  2. Let’s Talk Branding
  3. Branding Banter
  4. The Real World Branding
  5. Brands On Brands
  6. How Brands Are Built
  7. The Extraordinary Podcast
  8. Making the Brand
  9. Brand Design Masters Podcast
  10. Branding Love Letters

Check out my list of the best branding podcasts to listen to.

1. On Branding Podcast

Not to brag, but if you want to know what it takes to brand a business, the On Branding Podcast by yours truly is a must-listen to branding podcast for you.

The On Branding Podcast will help you learn everything branding.

In this podcast, I — Arek Dvornechuck, interview entrepreneurs and brand consultants to help you learn first-hand from the experts.

On Branding Podcast has weekly discussions and interviews that talk about branding, strategy, and design.‍

It is one of the best podcasts about branding, and you can learn a lot of things regardless of whether you’re just a startup in the industry, or a more advanced one.

This podcast includes interviews with big names in the industry like Michael Johnson (owner of Johnson Banks) in which we discussed about how to define and design brands.‍

Guests include:

  • Martin Neumeier
  • Michael Johnson
  • Bill Garner
  • Dauglas Davis
  • Denise Lee Yohn

Listen on:

  • On Branding Podcast — Apple Podcasts
  • On Branding Podcast — Google Podcasts
  • On Branding Podcast — Spotify

So if you want to learn everything about branding, especially how you can effectively build a brand, include the On Branding Podcast on your list.

2. Branding Banter

If you want to know how branding helps businesses connect with their customers, Branding Banter might be the one for you.

A podcast about the impact of branding on small Australian businesses.

This is an Aussie podcast hosted by Frank and Delphy, who are both professional Australian branding and design consultants.

By listening to this podcast, you’ll learn how to create a captivating brand that can be an asset and create a memorable connection between your brand and your customers.

Frank and Delphy will share with you some insights on how you can successfully grow your business.

Brand Banter podcast also highlights the impact of branding on small businesses.

Listen on:

  • Branding Banter — Apple Podcast
  • Branding Banter — Google Podcast
  • Branding Banter — Spotify

So if you’re an entrepreneur that wants to become a branding expert, Brand Banter is a great choice for you.

3. The Real World Branding

Real-World Branding is a podcast for and about brand and business building, hosted by Bill Gullan, President of Finch Brands.

The Real-World Branding podcast can help you learn how to build an authentic brand.

Each bi-weekly episode features a fast-paced interview with a brand development practitioner in an interesting category.

Guests talk about their careers and the challenges and opportunities associated with their companies and branding today.

‍Real-World Branding is a smart, practical podcast focused on what it takes to build, run, and grow successful brands in the real world

‍One of the best episodes of this podcast is when Bill Gullan and Phil Rubin discuss how to build an authentic brand.

Guests include:

  • Aimee Soto
  • Darren Sudman
  • Renne Dunn
  • Aishah hunter Sr.
  • Seth Young

Listen on:

  • The Real World Braning — Apple Podcast
  • The Real World Braning — Google Podcast
  • The Real World Braning — Spotify

So if you're looking for a podcast that will help on building your brand, the Real-World Branding is a must-listen podcast for you.

4. Brands On Brands

If you’re a consultant, coach, entrepreneur, or content creator that wants to know more about personal branding, the Brands on Brands Podcast has got your back.

Brands on Brands is the best podcast for personal branding.

This podcast is hosted by Brandon Birkmeyer, a brand strategist and marketing consultant with over 18 years of experience working with Fortune 100 brands.

He has experience working on the most popular and well-known brands such as Coca-Cola, Apple, Walmart, and Wells Fargo, so rest assured that you’ll learn from a master.

This podcast aims to teach you how to build authority and position yourself as the # 1 in your industry from the world's top personal branding and content marketing experts.

Brands on Brands Podcast is perfect for brand owners that want to be an expert in personal branding.

Guests include:

  • Joe Sanok
  • Lindsay Dotzlap
  • Brian Fanzo
  • Kelly Roach
  • Molly Mahoney

Listen on:

  • Brands on Brands — Apple Podcast
  • Brands on Brands — Google Podcast
  • Brands on Brands — Spotify

So if you’re looking for the best personal branding podcast to help you build and position yourself in the industry, you must consider listening to Brands On Brands.

5. How Brands Are Built

If you’re looking for a podcast that can help you learn how branding professionals become experts in their field, you must consider How Brands Are Built.

The best podcast to learn the details on building a brand.

This podcast is hosted by Rob Meyerson, who is a San Francisco-based professional brand strategist.

His podcast episodes include detailed interviews with other brand strategists, designers, researchers, and entrepreneurs.

Based on the podcast name itself, it mainly focuses on explaining how strong brands are built, as well as how you can apply it to your own brand.

Guests include:

  • Alina Wheeler
  • Nirm Shanbhag
  • Emily Heyward
  • Armin Vit
  • Sunny Bonnell

Listen on:

  • How Brand Are Built — Apple Podcast
  • How Brand Are Built — Google Podcast
  • How Brand Are Built — Spotify

So, if you want to know every detail about how to build a good and effective brand, How Brands Are Built is the podcast for you.

6. The Extraordinary Podcast

The Extraordinary Podcast must be included in your list if you want to learn how to expand your potential in the branding industry.

A podcast about growing extraordinary brands and businesses.

It is hosted by Tobias Dahlberg, a successful entrepreneur and strategist, in which he will help you learn the things that you must know about branding.

Tobias shared game-changing insights on the topics of brand and business development and personal growth.

‍The Extraordinary Podcast’s episodes include interviews with world-class thinkers and practitioners who already have years of experience in their field.

Rest assured that you will learn directly from experts about their best insights and wisdom and apply their ideas to your life, your brand, and your business.

Guests include:

  • Scott Goodson
  • James Coulson
  • Joe Pine
  • Patrick Hanlon
  • Scott Gould

Listen on:

  • The Extraordinary Podcast — Apple Podcast
  • The Extraordinary Podcast — Google Podcast
  • The Extraordinary Podcast — Spotify

So if you want to have an idea on how you can create brands that will stand out, listen to The Extraordinary Podcast.

7. Making The Brand

If you want to know the stories of successful brand owners and how they achieve their success in the industry, Making The Brand is perfect for you.

Making The Brand will help you learn and apply branding expert strategies.

This podcast is hosted by Billy Draper, wherein he interviews founders and leaders of consumer-facing businesses, from sneakers to ice cream, and everything in between.

You will be able to listen to the untold stories of how brand owners are delighting their customers, plus intimate details about how some of the top companies build their brands.

This podcast also focuses on strategies and methods for entrepreneurs to use their personal brand to bring value to the world.

Guests include:

  • Andrew Dudum
  • Steven Galanis
  • Benjamin Witte
  • Amy Nelson
  • Eric Ryan

Listen on:

  • Making The Brand — Apple Podcast
  • Making The Brand — Google Podcast
  • Making The Brand — Podyssey Podcast

So if you want to learn how you can take your brand to the next level, you must include Making The Brand on your podcast list.

8. Brand Design Masters Podcast

If you’re looking for a great podcast to listen to that will help you enhance your skills as a brand owner, the Brand Design Masters Podcast is for you.

A podcast that will help you learn how to build a bulletproof brand.

It is hosted by a highly accomplished creative leader named Philip VanDusen, who has two decades of experience in strategic branding, graphic design, and creative leadership.

He is a true expert in the branding industry, and he used to work with some of the world's most successful global retailers and consumer products companies.

Its episodes include sharing professional insights on how you can create a strong brand for yourself, your business, and the clients and customers you serve.

By listening to Philip, his co-hosts, and guests, you will surely learn how you can build a successful creative practice, business, and personal brand in the Creative Economy.

Guests include:

  • Lauren Gonzalez
  • Jozelle Tech
  • Christine Mau
  • Jesse Showalter
  • Laura Perman

Listen on:

  • Branding Design Master Podcast — Apple Podcast
  • Branding Design Master Podcast — Google Podcast
  • Branding Design Master Podcast — Spotify

If you're looking for a branding podcast that will teach you on how you can build a strong brand, Brand Design Masters Podcast is for you.

9. Brands on Brands on Brands

The next podcast on my list is the Brands on Brands on Brands Podcast (nice name!) run by Brandon Birkmeyer who is a marketing consultant and brand strategist.

A top-rated podcast focused on personal branding and content marketing.

If you’re looking for a great podcast to listen to that will help you build your personal brand, The Brands on Brands Podcast is for you.

It is hosted by branding expert Brandon Birkmeyer, who has nearly 20 years of experience in marketing, advertising, and strategic branding.

He is a true authority on personal branding, and he helps people build their reputations and grow their audiences online.

Its episodes provide professional insights on how you can create a strong personal brand for yourself and your business.

By listening to Brandon, you will learn strategies on how to build a successful brand and thrive in the digital economy.

Guests include:

  • John Lee Dumas
  • Evan Carmichael
  • Chris Ducker

Listen on:

  • Brands on Brands Podcast — Apple Podcasts
  • Brands on Brands Podcast — Google Podcasts
  • Brands on Brands Podcast — Spotify

If you want to learn how to build a powerful personal brand, Brands on Brands on Brands Podcast is a must-listen.

10. Branding Love Letters

Next on my podcast list is Branding Love Letters, hosted by experienced brand designer Sam Thorogood.

A podcast that features top guests discussing their favorite brands and why they matter to them.

Sam believes a brand and an emotional connection with the audience is key to brand's success.

This podcast features personal stories from individuals who have formed emotional connections with brands.

Each episode is released on the 14th of the month, and it features a top guest who picks their favorite brand.

They talk about why these brands are important to them, sharing insights into what makes people feel connected.

Listening to Sam, you'll discover that this podcast emphasizes the true measure of successful branding—emotion.

Guests include:

  • Levina Kusumadjaja
  • Keva Epale
  • Flora Aliaga
  • Steve Folland
  • Anneli Hansson

Listen on:

  • Branding Love Letters Podcast—Apple Podcasts
  • Branding Love Letters Podcast—Google Podcasts
  • Branding Love Letters Podcast—Spotify

If you want to gain invaluable insights on what makes audiences tick, Branding Love Letters is a must-listen.

Conclusions

Branding is one of the most important things to learn for you to successfully build your brand.‍

Although there are a lot of resources for it, including books, courses, and etc., podcasts are one of the smartest and most efficient ways to choose.

Aside from the fact that it is easy to access, you can also be guaranteed that you will only learn from the experts.‍

Additionally, listening to branding podcasts gives you entertainment, so you can learn without feeling bored.

In this article, I shared with you my top podcasts about branding, which are mostly available on Spotify and other platforms.

However, if you’re looking for an all-in-one podcast wherein you can learn everything about branding, the On Branding Podcast is the best choice for you.

Now that I’m done highlighting my top 10 list, which do you think is the best branding podcast for businesses and brand owners?— Leave a comment below.
